blocks.x: I know them, but I hadn't forgotten their name. Are your feet heighten you?
Yeah, a little bit. It's hot weather, you know. We may have a hot day like that. You like the change down here?
Be cool up there while you came from there.
Well, I stay here now. I live here.
Yeah, I've been here for 11 years now.
Oh, you done got used to it.
I'm used to it. I don't like it here.
About 30 years ago, we used to have some cold weather here. Cold.
Well, I've seen you get cold long jobs where guys were playing, you know.
